items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Y'all played on Saturday nights for him out there.

ctx.x: That's something unusual. I guess you could get the first pace easy that way. You could strike out pretty easy too. I guess you could stay long enough. Yeah. Who played with you over in McDonaldville? Who about? In the ballpark in McDonaldville. Did you work over there? Was he in the band or was he in the band or was he in the band or was he in the band or was he in the band? Yeah, I was standing there. I was standing there. I was standing there.

Oh, I see the bandwagon used to play that. And they used to play penny quarters for Chicken, what's that white man name out there? What? You know, you forget, Lord. The white man, Joe Powell. Oh. They called him Chicken Powell. That's right. Y'all played on Saturday nights for him out there. That's right. In New York.
